name: Designora Blocks
author: Kiran

sections.description:
Designora Blocks adds a collection of corporate-style blocks and ready-made block patterns to the WordPress block editor.

Blocks

29 blocks (36 including child blocks) in a “Designora” category in the block inserter, styled in a navy and teal corporate look:

  • Layout and content: Section Heading, Button, Image With Quote Card, Gallery (with lightbox), Call To Action, Icon Box / Service Card
  • Data: Counter, Progress Bar, Pricing Table, Testimonial, Team Member
  • Interactive: Slider, Tabs, Accordion, Timeline
  • Posts: Post Grid, Post Carousel
  • Navigation: Menu with dropdowns and Mega Menu items
  • Layout and text: Section, Container, Columns, Heading (with teal highlight), Text, List, Icon, Buttons, Social Links, Spacer
  • Pattern Library: a placeholder block that opens the pattern library; the chosen pattern replaces it

All blocks render on the server, load their CSS and JavaScript only on pages that use them, and work without any external service.

Block patterns

48 ready-made corporate sections in a navy and teal style. Browse them with the “Designora Patterns” button in the editor toolbar (search, categories, live previews, click to insert) or under the “Designora” category in the inserter’s Patterns tab:

  • Headers and banners: header with navigation, hero variations (photo panel, centred, split, slider, video), page title
  • About: about sections, mission and vision, company history timeline, client logos
  • Services and features: card, icon grid, zigzag, dark cards, tabs, feature checklists
  • Process and numbers: steps, accordion process, stats bands, skill bars
  • People: team grids, testimonials, careers
  • Conversion: pricing tables, FAQs, call-to-action bands, contact strips
  • Content and contact: blog grid and carousel, case studies, gallery, contact sections
  • Footers and utility pages: three footers, 404, coming soon

Every pattern is built only from Designora blocks, which are rendered by the plugin. If the plugin is deactivated, pattern content is not shown; re-activating it restores the content unchanged. Artwork, icons and the font (Inter) are stored in the plugin folder, and nothing is loaded from a remote API or CDN.

Credits

  • Inter typeface by The Inter Project Authors, SIL Open Font License 1.1 (assets/fonts/inter/LICENSE.txt).
sections.installation:
1. Upload the designora-blocks folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” screen in WordPress.
sections.changelog:
0.6.0

  • Added the Pattern Library block: insert it anywhere to open the pattern library, and the chosen pattern takes its place.

0.5.0

  • All 48 patterns are now built only from Designora blocks; pattern content is hidden while the plugin is inactive and restored on re-activation.
  • Added 12 foundation blocks: Section, Container, Columns, Column, Heading, Text, List, Icon, Buttons, Social Links and Spacer, plus a teal Highlight text format.
  • Accordion, Tabs and Mega Menu now insert Designora blocks by default.
  • Multi-card carousels hide their arrows below 1200px when dots are shown.

0.4.0

  • Added 43 block patterns (48 in total) with new Features, Process, Stats & Numbers, Pricing, FAQ and Utility Pages categories.
  • The pattern library lists patterns in page order and loads previews as you scroll.
  • Fixed double arrows on paragraph “link arrow” links, counter labels on dark bands, and timeline items skipped by anchor links.

0.3.0

  • Added 18 blocks (24 including child blocks) in a “Designora” block category.
  • Added a shared, dependency-free carousel used by Slider and Post Carousel.

0.2.0

  • Added five corporate block patterns in a “Designora” pattern category.
  • Added a pattern stylesheet with a locally bundled Inter font.

0.1.0

  • Initial plugin skeleton.

designora/list.name: designora/list
designora/list.title: List
designora/list.description: Check list, bullets, numbers, arrows or an inline row of links in the navy and teal style. Adapts to dark bands.

designora/slider.name: designora/slider
designora/slider.title: Slider
designora/slider.description: Full-width hero slider. Each slide has a background image, an overlay and any blocks inside a floating white panel.

designora/counter.name: designora/counter
designora/counter.title: Counter
designora/counter.description: Animated statistic: a big teal number with a label, as a navy stat card or a plain centred counter.

designora/post-carousel.name: designora/post-carousel
designora/post-carousel.title: Post Carousel
designora/post-carousel.description: Carousel of blog cards: image with an overlapping white panel, meta, title, excerpt and a Know More link.

designora/post-grid.name: designora/post-grid
designora/post-grid.title: Post Grid
designora/post-grid.description: Grid of blog cards: image with an overlapping white panel, meta, title, excerpt and a Know More link.

designora/pricing-table.name: designora/pricing-table
designora/pricing-table.title: Pricing Table
designora/pricing-table.description: Square pricing card with plan name, price, feature list and button. Featured plans use a navy fill.

description.default: Everything a growing team needs to plan with confidence.

designora/pattern-browser.name: designora/pattern-browser
designora/pattern-browser.title: Pattern Library
designora/pattern-browser.description: Opens the Designora pattern library. Pick a ready-made section and it replaces this block.

designora/icon.name: designora/icon
designora/icon.title: Icon
designora/icon.description: Outline icon from the Designora set (or your own image), plain, in a square or circle, or as a video play button. Optionally linked.

designora/cta.name: designora/cta
designora/cta.title: Call To Action
designora/cta.description: Photo band with a navy overlay, white title and text, buttons and an optional video play button.

title.default: Ready To Take Your Business Further?

text.default: Talk to an advisor today and get a clear, practical plan for the year ahead. No jargon, no obligation.

designora/team-member.name: designora/team-member
designora/team-member.title: Team Member
designora/team-member.description: Portrait with name, teal role, short bio and contact links, with a white panel overlapping the photo.

designora/testimonial.name: designora/testimonial
designora/testimonial.title: Testimonial
designora/testimonial.description: Client quote with name, role, avatar and star rating, as a bordered card, a centred band or a dark card.

quote.default: Working with this team transformed the way we plan. Clear advice, honest numbers and a partner who genuinely cares about our growth.

designora/heading.name: designora/heading
designora/heading.title: Heading
designora/heading.description: Navy title-case heading (H1–H6) that turns white on dark bands. Supports a teal highlighted word.

designora/progress-bar.name: designora/progress-bar
designora/progress-bar.title: Progress Bar
designora/progress-bar.description: Labelled skill or progress bar with square ends that fills when scrolled into view.

designora/container.name: designora/container
designora/container.title: Container
designora/container.description: Box that stacks, lines up or grids its blocks, with optional white panel, navy panel, tint or border.

designora/buttons.name: designora/buttons
designora/buttons.title: Buttons
designora/buttons.description: A row of Designora buttons and text links.

designora/text.name: designora/text
designora/text.title: Text
designora/text.description: Paragraph text in the navy and teal style: body, lead, small, eyebrow, label, muted or quote. Adapts to dark bands.

attributes.content: We help growing companies plan, finance and scale with confidence.

designora/image.name: designora/image
designora/image.title: Image With Quote Card
designora/image.description: Square-cornered image with optional aspect ratio, hover zoom, link, caption and a floating white quote card.

cardText.default: Clear advice, honest numbers and a team that answers the phone. They changed how we plan our year.

designora/button.name: designora/button
designora/button.title: Button
designora/button.description: Square-cornered call-to-action button or text link in the navy and teal style.

designora/spacer.name: designora/spacer
designora/spacer.title: Spacer
designora/spacer.description: Vertical white space, optionally with a thin divider line or a short teal accent.

designora/columns.name: designora/columns
designora/columns.title: Columns
designora/columns.description: Two, three or four columns side by side that stack on smaller screens.

designora/timeline.name: designora/timeline
designora/timeline.title: Timeline
designora/timeline.description: Vertical company timeline: dated milestones in white cards along a line with square teal markers.

designora/icon-box.name: designora/icon-box
designora/icon-box.title: Icon Box / Service Card
designora/icon-box.description: Service card: image with an overlapping white panel, teal outline icon, title, text and a View Details link. Turns navy on hover.

text.default: Clear plans built on real numbers, so every decision moves the business forward.

designora/tabs.name: designora/tabs
designora/tabs.title: Tabs
designora/tabs.description: Accessible tabs with an underline or boxed style. Each tab holds any blocks.

designora/gallery.name: designora/gallery
designora/gallery.title: Gallery
designora/gallery.description: Square-cornered image grid or masonry with hover zoom and an accessible lightbox.

designora/social.name: designora/social
designora/social.title: Social Icons
designora/social.description: Row of square social and contact icons (LinkedIn, X, Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, email, phone, website) in the navy and teal style.

designora/section-heading.name: designora/section-heading
designora/section-heading.title: Section Heading
designora/section-heading.description: Italic teal eyebrow, large navy title and intro text, centred, left-aligned or as a three-column row with a button.

text.default: We combine practical experience with fresh thinking to help companies plan ahead, reduce risk and grow with confidence.

designora/section.name: designora/section
designora/section.title: Section
designora/section.description: Full-width band: white, tinted or navy background, or a photo with an overlay. Holds any blocks inside a centred content width.

designora/menu.name: designora/menu
designora/menu.title: Menu
designora/menu.description: Self-contained navigation menu built from Menu Item and Mega Menu blocks, with drop-downs, mega panels and a mobile toggle.

designora/accordion.name: designora/accordion
designora/accordion.title: Accordion
designora/accordion.description: FAQ accordion built on native details/summary: square rows, the open row's title and plus/minus icon turn teal.

designora/slide.name: designora/slide
designora/slide.title: Slide
designora/slide.description: A single slide: background image, overlay and content.

designora/column.name: designora/column
designora/column.title: Column
designora/column.description: A single column inside Columns. Holds any blocks.

designora/accordion-item.name: designora/accordion-item
designora/accordion-item.title: Accordion Item
designora/accordion-item.description: One accordion row: a question (summary) and any blocks as the answer.

designora/tab.name: designora/tab
designora/tab.title: Tab
designora/tab.description: A single tab: a label, an optional icon and any blocks as its panel content.

designora/menu-item.name: designora/menu-item
designora/menu-item.title: Menu Item
designora/menu-item.description: A link in a Designora menu. Add Menu Items inside it to build a drop-down submenu.

designora/timeline-item.name: designora/timeline-item
designora/timeline-item.title: Timeline Item
designora/timeline-item.description: One milestone: a date or label, a title, a short text and an optional marker icon.

designora/mega-menu-item.name: designora/mega-menu-item
designora/mega-menu-item.title: Mega Menu
designora/mega-menu-item.description: A top-level menu link that opens a wide white panel holding any blocks (columns of links, a promo, …).
